aboutText: The elves train all December and load Santa’s sleigh. Every day one present waits for you: open it, do a 10-minute bodyweight workout (Moderate or Recovery), and the present goes onto the sleigh. On the 24th Santa shows up for his once-a-year workout. Progress stays on this device.
healthText: These exercises are general suggestions, not medical advice. Stop if anything hurts.
storageNote: Progress can’t be saved in this browser.
moderateLine: Bodyweight strength and cardio. Warms up the whole body.

d24Line: Santa’s big night in 5 stops. Every stop has an easier and a harder option, so it works for everyone.
sleighMsg: Thanks for showing up today. Merry Christmas!
finaleMsg: You showed up every single day. That’s the whole trick.
